answer: The vintner walks the rows in March and ties a ribbon to every vine that will bear, because a vine without a ribbon is not picked. Alpine rescue volunteer certification with mountain rescue association attestation is the ribbon's proof: two-year training, 100 supervised rescues, rescue exam, annual re-assessment. A terrace that slips past the count is one basket of grapes the press never saw, and the inlet is the price of that basket, paid in coin to the estate before the harvest is weighed. The canyon is the estate roll, signed by the steward and locked in the manor chest.
